notes: SCOPE: this is the CoA (custom hero class) talent panel: a spec picker (SpecView, CoASpecChoiceTemplate per spec) and a two-tree view (ClassTree = tab 'Class' with AE gate currency 383080, SpecTree = the active spec tab with TE gate currency 383081) plus a footer (spec/build dropdown popups, Save/Undo/Reset/Deactivate/Share/Import/ChangeSpec, search box). It contains almost no logic of its own: rendering is TalentTreeBaseMixin (Ascension_TalentUI) + the FrameXML/CharacterAdvancement base mixins; state is 100% native C_CharacterAdvancement. LOAD ORDER: LoadOnDemand, deps Ascension_TalentUI + Ascension_Collections; the frame is parent="Collections" so Collections must exist first, and Collections only registers the CoATalentFrame tab when IsCustomClass() is true at Collections OnLoad (a stock-class character gets Ascension_CharacterAdvancement instead) - the shim's UnitClass override must already return the CoA token when Ascension_Collections loads. XML ATTRIBUTE CONVENTION: TalentTreeBase reads its config from XML <Attribute> strings; values starting with 'global:' are resolved to _G lookups by AttributesToKeyValues (SharedXML/Util/Util.lua:96) - CoATalentFrame.xml overrides getNodeTemplate/getChoiceNodeTemplate/getConnectionTemplate/getGateTemplate/getGateAttachmentPoint/gateCurrencyCount/getEntryGateRequirement per tree, while getEntries (C_CharacterAdvancement.GetEntriesByClass) and getPosition (CharacterAdvancementUtil.GetEntryPosition, which uses PositionX/PositionY because Enum.Class[token] >= CustomStart) come from the TalentTreeBase template defaults (Ascension_TalentUI.xml:27-42). NAME SPACES: three different 'class/spec' identifiers flow through this addon - (1) UnitClass file token (TINKER), (2) DBC token (Tinker / Firearms) from ClassConversions, used for every C_CharacterAdvancement call, (3) specInfo.ID number used for GetActiveChrSpec/SwitchActiveChrSpec/GetSpecInfoByID; never join them by offset (memory: join CoA id spaces by NAME). Also GetActiveSpecID (Hero Architect spec slot) is a different id from GetActiveChrSpec. TREE BUILD TIMING: SetClassTab only marks dirty; BuildTree runs from an OnUpdate, so it happens on the first frame the tree is visible, not at load - GetEntriesByClass etc. are therefore 'on show' natives. TalentTreeBase.lua:317-321 asserts class/tab/getEntries/getPosition/getNodeTemplate. DUPLICATE CoATalentFrame.xml TreeView Background2 is commented out; Background3 uses an alpha animation (AnimationGroup Alpha with change=, stock 3.3.5a Alpha animations support change). COMPAT LAYER GAPS vs DESIGN §3 (which plans only .lua from Ascension FrameXML): this addon inherits XML templates from Ascension's FrameXML - SimpleRankFrameTemplate (+SimpleRankMixin, FrameXML/UIPanelTemplates.xml:1339/.lua:888), SpecializationMenuTemplate (+SpecListItemTemplate, FrameXML/SpecializationMenu.xml:76, SpecListItem.xml:89, SpecializationMenu.lua, needs SpecializationUtil which at file load calls ReadCustomWTF + C_Serialize:DeserializeDecompressFromPrint and reads SPEC_SWAP_SPELLS from FrameXML/Constants.lua:973), CATalentBaseTemplate/CATalentChoiceBaseTemplate/CAGateBaseTemplate/CALineConnectionTemplate/LocationIndicatorTemplate (FrameXML/CharacterAdvancement/CharacterAdvancementBaseTemplates.xml + 6 .lua incl. CATalentArtMixin which needs TalentButtonUtil from FrameXML/Util/TalentUtil.lua and TextureUtil.MaskSize / Icon:SetIconMask), GameFontNormalHuge2 (FrameXML/FontStyles.xml:122), plus the FrameXML/Util files CharacterAdvancementUtil.lua (also depends on Enum.CALearnResult, C_Config, C_GameMode, AtlasUtil, ItemData, Item, C_Realm.IsLive, IsConquestOfAzerothPlayer), BuildCreatorUtil.lua (CallbackRegistryMixin, SpecializationUtil, C_BuildDraft.GetDraftedBuild is referenced but only in GetDraftedBuildID), C_PrimaryStat.lua (PRIMARY_STAT_NAME_FORMAT), Constants.lua (COA_AUTO_SHOW_TALENTS_LEVEL, SPEC_SWAP_SPELLS), StaticPopup.lua dialog entries, GameTooltip.lua:1264 GameTooltip_GenericTooltip, UIParent.lua entries (UIPanelWindows.Collections, UIParentLoadAddOn, CharacterAdvancement_LoadUI, ToggleCollections) and the LoadAddOn override in GlobalOverwrites.lua:471. The stock UIPanelDialogTemplate does provide parentKey="title" (stock UIPanelTemplates.xml:1016), so SpecializationMenuMixin's self.title is fine; the stock UIDropDownMenuTemplate does NOT provide .Button - ship Ascension's SharedXML/UIDropDownMenuTemplates.xml (and UIDropDownMenu.lua) or the frame errors in OnLoad. HERO ARCHITECT SUBSYSTEM: the BuildCreatorMenu / DeactivateBuild / ShareBuild / ImportBuild paths are optional for a first release; if C_BuildCreator.QueryAllBuilds never answers, the popup just shows its Loading overlay forever, and BuildCreatorUtil.ContinueOnLoad tries to load Ascension_BuildCreator (BuildCreator_LoadUI) whenever GetActiveBuild returns a non-empty id - return nil/'' from the shim to keep that addon out. UpdateDropDowns (CoATreeViewMixin.lua:162-183) has a quirk: it always resets the BuildDropDown text to TALENTS_IMPORT_HERO_ARCHITECT after scheduling ContinueOnLoad, so the build name only shows if the callback runs asynchronously later. RESET: 'Reset all' uses ClearPendingBuild(OnlyClearAllowed=true); per-tree reset uses ClearPendingBuildByTab(classDBC, tabDBC, true) because C_Player:IsCustomClass(). CANCEL HOOK: RefreshFromCancel is set by hooksecurefunc on C_CharacterAdvancement.CancelPendingBuild and consumed on the next PENDING_BUILD_UPDATED - so the shim's CancelPendingBuild must both exist at load and fire that event afterwards (even when nothing was pending) or UpdateActiveSpec is skipped. CLOSE FLOW: OnHide with IsPending() shows CLOSE_CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_UNSAVED_PENDING_CHANGES whose GO_BACK reopens the tab; OnShow hides that popup. FOOTER SLASH COMMANDS write CoATalentFooterLayoutDB (SavedVariables) and re-anchor the footer; harmless. SOUNDS: 4 SOUNDKIT keys + node spend/refund sounds; all numeric kit ids. CoAReader (C:\AzerothRealm\client-ascension\Interface\AddOns\Ascension_CoAReader, James's local tool, archive-gated) already proves the two-tree render works for ANY class/spec by calling ClassTree:SetClassTab(classDBC,'Class') and TreeView:SetSpecID(id) directly - the shim's selftest can reuse that path.
